sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small evergreen shrub endemic to Mauritius, reaching about 1.5 m. Its wild populations are highly localized.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The large bright pink to carmine flowers are about 7–10 cm across and have a distinctive staminal column. The fruit is a capsule.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented in the sources consulted.

sources.title: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew — Islands Flora Collection
